notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.11
notes.notes: [p] Hello everyone and Happy Tuesday.[/p][p][/p][p]Some tweaks and fixes incoming. Bort has more maps to help those who may want a hint. Also increased the drop rate of stuff, hopefully you should now have more ammo to go pew pew. [/p][p][/p][p]Marcel -dev[/p][p][/p][h1]v1.0.11[/h1][p][/p][h2]🎮[b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Increased base drop rate of health, ammo and SpaceBucks[/p][/*][*][p]Lower the cost of buying rayguns from Floid[/p][/*][*][p]Put some more maps into Bort's Map Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Make it clearer when purchasing Rayguns from Floid that you can only carry one side weapon[/p][/*][*][p]Lower the HP of the candles in Galactabatory so they can be smashed quicker[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]🎨[b]ART & ANIMATION[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Add new icon for Bort's maps[/p][/*][*][p]Improve Melish's death animation[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]🛠️[b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fix an interaction with a Badge that could cause the Pirate Ship to appear destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]Fix an erroneous UI prompt in the Debris Field[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix v1.0.9
notes.notes:
[p]Hi Space Cadets,[/p][p]
Thanks to your feedback I've fixed a bug that unlocked a shortcut gate to the Galactabatory. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]NOTE: If you are currently stuck there, you can now simply 'teleport' out using the map, it should bring you back safely on to Quamar Station[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][/p][h1][b]v1.0.9[/b][/h1][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]🐛 BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Fix for an unintentional premature skip to the Galactabatory, the doorway was being unlocked causing the player to end up stuck there[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing and thanks for your help in improving the game.[/p][p]Marcel -dev[/p]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update! "Attack of the Wokels!"
notes.notes: [p]Hey there Raygunners![/p][p][/p][p]Hope you're all having a great Steam Next Fest. I've tried out a few demos myself. It's been really cool to see what awesome games are on the horizon.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who has played the demo and wishlisted the game. I've enjoyed hearing all your feedback both praise and critique. I've listened closely to what you've been saying and there's been a common refrain involving the enemy's passivity and lack of action on the Planet Doutien. So with that in mind, I am happy to announce....[/p][p][/p][h1]The Attack of the Wokels Update![/h1][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/b4a41fd69a5dff08eb01396810fa61a8b8be98b1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's New?[/h2][p][/p][h3]The Wokels Have Gone Crazy + New Enemies and Variants[/h3][p][b]The Wokels have gone crazy![/b]  I dunno what they ate but they're aggressive and want to eat your face. They will now chase you down. There's also new Wokel enemies that jump! Yikes! [i](What have I done.)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]There are also new attacks for other enemies you'll meet in the demo. New enemy placements and even some enemies that weren't part of the previous version. [b]So more variety and more action and excitement![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/d140cd5658949c413375970ddaeb755f35eeae77.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]A Brand New Ability, the Down Stab Attack[/h3][p][/p][p]To help you deal with this new Wokel threat I am pleased to introduce a new Attack. The Down Stab. Skewer your foes and get a boost up into the air as a bonus. Hmm. Could use this as a traversal.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/ca304305fd9fc99fc8a083ffac4d7a09ff633a6c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32462473/1378bde7e7893ecdbcda50371c1a42b68dc5152a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]In Closing[/h3][p][/p][p]Thanks again and let me know what you think about the changes. [b]You can of course post a comment here on this post or[/b] [b]join the game's Discord and come say hello![/b][/p][p][/p][p] 🌟👉[url="https://discord.gg/raygungadabout" style="button"]DISCORD LINK[/url][b] 👈🌟[/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you among the stars,[/p][p][/p][p]Marcel -dev[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]
